brief: Marketing landing page for "Nubo", an e-invoicing SaaS for small businesses. Sections in this order: hero (headline, subheadline and call-to-action button), features (6 cards with a title and text), pricing (3 plans: Basic, Pro and Enterprise, each with a monthly price, a list of benefits and a button; the Pro plan highlighted; a monthly/yearly toggle that applies a 20% discount to the yearly price), FAQ (6 questions that expand and collapse) and a contact form (name, email and message; live validation: name not empty, email contains @, message of 10 characters or more; Send button disabled while invalid; on submit it shows "Thanks, we'll be in touch soon"). A single view with <meta seo>. Accessible (SPEC §8) and using only the available tokens.
